'''''Gēng''''' ({{zh|c=羹|p=gēng|poj=keⁿ / kiⁿ|w=keng1}}) is a type of thick or clear [[soup]] found in [[Chinese cuisine]]. Its thickening agent is usually [[starch]], which makes the soup translucent and smooth. Many soups can be cooked in this way, such as [[shark fin soup]], [[Madame Song's fish soup]] (宋嫂魚羹), and [[corn soup]].
